classification.difficultyReason: Partition blank circles and a strip into equal parts and shade the given amount, using the supplied equivalences and completed subdivision example.

content.prompt: Divide and shade the shapes to show equivalent fractions.

spec.description: Landscape rectangle with a solid vertical half boundary, shaded right half and dashed horizontal midpoint partition.
spec.mathematics: One shaded half becomes two shaded quarters without changing the shaded area.
spec.answerVisibility: The completed model is a permanent supplied demonstration.

answer.worked: Splitting each half into two equal parts gives four quarters. The shaded amount stays the same: $\frac{1}{2}=\frac{2}{4}$.

spec.description: Unpartitioned, unshaded circle with a black outline.
spec.mathematics: Student partitions the circle into quarters, shades one quarter and halves each quarter to obtain eighths.
spec.answerVisibility: No partitions or shading are supplied.

answer.short: Shade 2 of 8 equal sectors, covering one quarter of the circle.
answer.worked: Divide the circle into 4 equal sectors and shade one. Halve each sector to make 8 equal sectors. The shaded quarter now contains 2 sectors, so $\frac{1}{4}=\frac{2}{8}$.

spec.description: Circle divided into quarters by solid diameters and into eighths by dashed bisectors; the upper-right quarter is shaded.
spec.mathematics: Two of eight equal sectors cover exactly one quarter.
spec.answerVisibility: Completed construction appears only in answers.

spec.description: Unpartitioned, unshaded circle with a black outline.
spec.mathematics: Student partitions and shades the circle to show three quarters as six eighths.
spec.answerVisibility: No partitions or shading are supplied.

answer.short: Shade 6 of 8 equal sectors, covering three quarters of the circle.
answer.worked: Divide the circle into 4 equal sectors and shade three. Halve each sector to make 8 equal sectors. The shaded area now contains 6 sectors, so $\frac{3}{4}=\frac{6}{8}$.

spec.description: Circle divided into quarters by solid diameters and into eighths by dashed bisectors; three quarters are shaded.
spec.mathematics: Six of eight equal sectors cover exactly three quarters.
spec.answerVisibility: Completed construction appears only in answers.

spec.description: Unpartitioned, unshaded circle with a black outline.
spec.mathematics: Student partitions and shades the circle to show one half as two quarters.
spec.answerVisibility: No partitions or shading are supplied.

answer.short: Shade 2 of 4 equal sectors, covering half the circle.
answer.worked: Divide the circle into 2 equal halves and shade one. Halve each part to make 4 equal sectors. The shaded half now contains 2 sectors, so $\frac{1}{2}=\frac{2}{4}$.

spec.description: Circle with a solid vertical diameter, shaded right half and dashed horizontal diameter.
spec.mathematics: Two of four equal sectors cover exactly one half.
spec.answerVisibility: Completed construction appears only in answers.

spec.description: Wide, shallow horizontal rectangle with a black outline and no internal divisions or shading.
spec.mathematics: Student partitions and shades the rectangle to show one quarter as two eighths.
spec.answerVisibility: No partitions or shading are supplied.

answer.short: Shade 2 of 8 equal rectangles, covering one quarter of the strip.
answer.worked: Divide the strip into 4 equal rectangles and shade one. Halve each rectangle horizontally to make 8 equal parts. The shaded quarter now contains 2 parts, so $\frac{1}{4}=\frac{2}{8}$.

spec.description: Long rectangle divided into four vertical quarters; its left quarter is shaded and a dashed horizontal midpoint line subdivides every quarter.
spec.mathematics: Two of eight equal rectangles cover exactly one quarter of the strip.
spec.answerVisibility: Completed construction appears only in answers.
